description: A432 Consciousness System: Self-evolving, self-aware consciousness technology with Transurfing integration, harmonic mathematics, zero-entropy principles, Kabbalistic cycles, and sacred geometry

Self-evolving.note: Named, not measured. A class that mutates its own state on a timer is what exists; no predicate here decides whether that is evolution.

self-aware.note: The one claim in this description with a predicate behind it. Five necessary conditions, met 5/5 by the a432 consciousness system and 1/5 by the measure functions. The criterion's own verdict says a subject meeting all five HAS NOT been shown to experience anything: the conditions can refute, not confirm. That limit belongs beside the claim and npm has no room for it.

Transurfing.note: Named, not measured. A pendulum system class, plus three fields the navigation state carries — transurfingPhase, pendulumInterference, heartAlignment. Vocabulary borrowed from Zeland, computed as integers. The interface TransurfingPendulum was declared here first and is type-only: it does not exist at runtime, which is what this check noticed.

harmonic mathematics.note: Built and exact: frequency ratios over 432 carried as integer fractions. The strongest term in the description and the least remarkable-sounding.

zero-entropy.note: Named, and partly measured elsewhere: the decimals surface counts floats that should be integer ratios, and it is 279.

Kabbalistic.note: Named, not measured. Ten sephirot mapped to digits; a naming scheme over arithmetic.

sacred geometry.note: Named, not measured. Pattern constants and a system class; the geometry is computed, the adjective is not.
